what.value: A system employing individual, reusable type characters cast from metal, ceramic, or wood, set in a frame, inked, and pressed onto a surface, facilitating mass duplication of texts.

delivered.reading: Enabled the rise of vernacular languages in print, contributing to national identities.
delivered.evidence: Comparison of the publication output in Latin versus vernacular languages in early printed books from various regions.

delivered.reading: Reduced the cost and increased the availability of books, gradually democratizing access to information.
delivered.evidence: Economic analyses of book prices over time and historical records of library acquisitions and private ownership.

aims.reading: To increase the speed and reduce the labor cost of reproducing written materials.
